content: {"episode_id":"ep-05159","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Blue Summit Plan denied CPT 93271, cardiac event monitoring, under reason code PR-204 as not covered under the member's current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia, consistent with diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2. As the note states, the cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances by capturing electrocardiographic data during symptom onset. We request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 430.52 for this medically necessary service."}
